info.title: Compose CD Engine agent v2
info.description: Opt-in private deployment API. No administrator approval authority in this API; see agent-authorization.md for the separate WebAuthn browser service.

post.description: Private-network POST. HMAC authenticates exact body bytes; timestamp tolerance ±60s and durable single-use request_id. Maximum 60000 bytes. Policy and active Project Grant enforced at Runner.

200.description: Bounded, sanitized result. Inspect status/grant_diff/task_id; HTTP 200 alone does not mean deployed.

403.description: Invalid HMAC, nonce, route, principal or framing.

503.description: Unavailable or outcome unknown; reconcile task/plan mapping before retry.
